svg.title: Atomic AI Design — six layers and the feedback loop
svg.desc: Five stacked bands, atomic at the bottom and product at the top, each with example units from the Compound Design repository. A sixth layer, feedback, is an arrow leaving the product band, passing real use, observation, failure, learning and new atom, and returning into the atomic band.

svg.text: A lens, not a taxonomy: the same file can sit in more than one layer depending on how it is used. Composition alone is a library; the loop is what "compound" means.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Examples are real paths in DaniloAmaralUX/compoundmetrics at the case-study freeze (2026-09-09). Verified chain: site-check → CD-20260909-013 → docs/solutions → rule in site-check.mjs. See ATOMIC-AI-DESIGN.md.
